source_text: When official traffic-control devices are erected at hazardous or congested places, a person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle in any such designated place.

comparison.condition_a: destination stop overlapping the device-designated polygon
comparison.condition_b: destination stop beyond the same designated polygon
comparison.deliberate_difference: observed vehicle-body overlap with the sourced designated polygon during rest
fixed: same official device and designated polygon

source_requirements.designation: original device content and authority record, including the actual designated place polygon; sign pose alone is insufficient
source_requirements.device: original official status, erection and active interval for all stop frames
source_requirements.map: original map coordinates and hazardous or congested physical context
source_requirements.native_trace: original 600-frame vehicle footprint, speed and person-caused stop timeline
source_requirements.video_frame_map: all 600 original 20 Hz time and video joins
source_requirements.traffic_and_directions: original traffic conflict and police or official-device directions, preserved for independent review
